description:
Moves the tests that call `LdpcDecoder::decode_batch` to the batch soft-decoder trait, keeping what they assert.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. A pooled batch decoder over the trait gives parallel decoding with one inner decoder per worker. `LdpcDecoder::decode_batch` and `decode_batch_with_config` predate the trait: they build one single-frame decoder per frame, on rayon under the `parallel` feature, and return message bits with iteration counts and flags. Their test callers are the unit tests beside them in `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/core.rs` and the integration test `crates/gf2-coding/tests/backend_integration.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each test that called `LdpcDecoder::decode_batch` or `decode_batch_with_config` decodes through the batch soft-decoder trait with the LDPC batch decoder, pooled where the test covered parallel decoding.
- [hard] REQ-02: The moved tests assert message bits, iteration counts and flags equal to per-frame `decode_iterative`, and an empty result for an empty batch.
- [hard] REQ-03: No test in `gf2-coding` calls the inherent batch functions.
title: Move the tests of the inherent LDPC batch functions to the batch trait
